sentences.en: I'm here tonight to announce my intention to seek the Republican nomination for president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 1980年，里根竞选总统，鲁珀特·默多克希望他获胜。

sentences.en: So in 1980, Reagan's running for president, and Rupert Murdoch wants him to win.
sentences.zh: 他让《纽约邮报》全力支持里根。

sentences.en: He puts the New York Post behind him.
sentences.zh: 我相信，只要齐心协力，我们就能赴这场与命运的约会。

sentences.en: I believe that together, we can keep this rendezvous with destiny.
sentences.zh: 他实际上帮助里根拿下了纽约州。

sentences.en: He helps actually deliver New York State to Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 里根对此感激不尽，两人由此建立了关系。

sentences.en: Reagan is enormously grateful, and a relationship is forged.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家，晚安。

sentences.en: Thank you, and good night.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家，晚安。

sentences.en: So now he has in the White House a friend, an ally, someone who owes him, and can help him kind of advance his agenda in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他在白宫有了一个朋友、一个盟友，一个欠他人情的人，可以帮他在美国推进他的议程。

sentences.en: And so that agenda early on includes getting into television.
sentences.zh: 而这个议程在早期就包括进军电视业。

sentences.en: And Rupert, you know, it was no problem for him to buy the New York Post, but in order to buy a TV station, you need to be an American citizen.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特，你知道，他收购《纽约邮报》毫无问题，但要收购电视台，你需要是美国公民。

sentences.en: It's federally regulated.
sentences.zh: 这是受联邦监管的。

sentences.en: So he has to get citizenship.
sentences.zh: 所以他必须获得公民身份。

sentences.en: Rupert Murdoch decided to become an American citizen so he could buy six American television stations.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特·默多克决定成为美国公民，这样他就能收购六家美国电视台。

sentences.en: And so he turns to Reagan, who fast-tracks his application.
sentences.zh: 于是他求助于里根，里根加快了他的申请审批。

sentences.en: As president.
sentences.zh: 以总统身份。

sentences.en: As president, and enables him to get into TV.
sentences.zh: 以总统身份，让他得以进入电视行业。

sentences.en: And does he, in fact, buy TV stations?
sentences.zh: 他真的收购了电视台吗？

sentences.en: He does indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实收购了。

sentences.en: And in fact, launches what becomes the Fox Network.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他还推出了后来成为福克斯电视网的频道。

sentences.en: And we're not talking about Fox News, but the Fox Broadcasting Network, which becomes this unlikely competitor to the big three broadcast networks.
sentences.zh: 我们说的不是福克斯新闻，而是福克斯广播电视网，它成为了三大广播电视网意想不到的竞争对手。

sentences.en: Starting on April 5th, you'll view Sundays in a whole new life.
sentences.zh: 从4月5日开始，你将以全新的方式度过周日。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So when I was growing up, it was ABC, CBS, NBC, and then suddenly there was Channel 5.
sentences.zh: 我成长的时候，电视只有ABC、CBS、NBC，然后突然出现了5频道。

sentences.en: Suddenly there was Channel 5, which was Fox, which— Which was Rupert Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 突然出现了5频道，也就是福克斯，也就是——也就是鲁珀特·默多克。

sentences.en: Which was Rupert Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 也就是鲁珀特·默多克。

sentences.en: This is the Fox Broadcasting Company.
sentences.zh: 这就是福克斯广播公司。

sentences.en: Okay, so by using this playbook, Rupert Murdoch is able to create this Fox Broadcasting Network.
sentences.zh: 好的，通过使用这套剧本，鲁珀特·默多克成功创建了福克斯广播电视网。

sentences.en: And what happens after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he also buys what was then known as 20th Century Fox, massive Hollywood studio.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他还收购了当时被称为二十世纪福克斯的巨型好莱坞制片厂。

sentences.en: The empire gets bigger and bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 帝国变得越来越大。

sentences.en: What do you think you're offering people that they would want to watch?
sentences.zh: 你认为你为人们提供了什么，让他们想要观看？

sentences.en: Choice.
sentences.zh: 选择。

sentences.en: Much more choice.
sentences.zh: 更多的选择。

sentences.en: And then in the mid-90s, he launches a 24-hour cable news channel, Fox News.
sentences.zh: 然后在90年代中期，他推出了24小时有线新闻频道——福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Bill O'Reilly.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是比尔·奥莱利。

sentences.en: Thank you for watching on our very first day.
sentences.zh: 感谢您在我们开播第一天的收看。

sentences.en: How did it happen?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: How did television news become so predictable and in some cases so boring?
sentences.zh: 电视新闻是怎么变得如此可预测，甚至在某些情况下如此无聊的？

sentences.en: Which, you know, very quickly becomes this incredibly powerful force in American politics.
sentences.zh: 而这，你知道，很快就变成了美国政治中一股极其强大的力量。

sentences.en: Few broadcasts take any chances these days, and most are very politically correct.
sentences.zh: 如今很少有广播节目敢于冒险，大多数都非常政治正确。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to try to be different, stimulating and a bit daring, but at the same time responsible and fair.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们要尝试变得与众不同，既要刺激、大胆一点，同时又要负责任且公正。

sentences.en: President Bush winning more votes than any president in history.
sentences.zh: 布什总统获得的选票比历史上任何一位总统都多。

sentences.en: But after another hour of Barack Obama explaining his program, I still don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 但在巴拉克·奥巴马又花了一个小时解释他的计划后，我仍然不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: The man is incapable of breaking it down so that we, the people, can understand it.
sentences.zh: 这个人无法将其拆解开来，让我们这些普通民众能够理解。

sentences.en: That's the crux of the matter.
sentences.zh: 这就是问题的症结所在。

sentences.en: It's supplemental.
sentences.zh: 这是补充性的。

sentences.en: It's elemental.
sentences.zh: 这是基础性的。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: What precisely is diversity our strength?
sentences.zh: “多元化就是我们的力量”到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: Since you've made this our new national motto, please be specific as you explain it.
sentences.zh: 既然你把它定为我们新的国家格言，请在解释时具体一点。

sentences.en: Can you think, for example, of other institutions, such as, I don't know, marriage or military units, in which the less people have in common, the more cohesive they are?
sentences.zh: 你能举出其他机构的例子吗，比如，我不知道，婚姻或军队，人们共同点越少，凝聚力就越强？

sentences.en: And at a certain point, Rupert Murdoch is in many ways dictating Republican policy.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，鲁珀特·默多克在许多方面都在左右共和党的政策。

sentences.en: He's leading the conservative movement in different directions.
sentences.zh: 他正引领保守派运动走向不同的方向。

sentences.en: Sean Hannity, come on up.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·汉尼提，上来吧。

sentences.en: Sean Hannity.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·汉尼提。

sentences.en: And in so doing, what it's really helping foment and add to is this populist wave.
sentences.zh: 这样做，他实际上是在煽动并助长这股民粹主义浪潮。

sentences.en: In the U.K., it's anti-Europe.
sentences.zh: 在英国，它是反欧洲的。

sentences.en: We won't fix this.
sentences.zh: 我们不会解决这个问题。

sentences.en: In the U.S., it's hell with all this PC culture, and he gets behind Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在美国，它是对所有政治正确文化的厌恶，他转而支持唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: So enter our times.
sentences.zh: 所以，进入我们的时代。

sentences.en: Like, here we are, Brexit and Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 就像现在这样，英国脱欧和唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: Build that wall.
sentences.zh: 筑起那道墙。

sentences.en: Build that wall.
sentences.zh: 筑起那道墙。

sentences.en: There are multiple forces behind all of this, and we'll be studying that for decades.
sentences.zh: 这一切背后有多种力量，我们将研究几十年。

sentences.en: But the common denominator is Rupert Murdoch and his media empire.
sentences.zh: 但共同点是鲁珀特·默多克和他的媒体帝国。

sentences.en: And so that is what his children are fighting over.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他的孩子们争夺的东西。

sentences.en: It is this media empire which has the power to change politics and governments all over the world.
sentences.zh: 正是这个媒体帝国拥有改变全世界政治和政府的力量。

sentences.en: That's what's at stake here when Rupert falls on his son's yacht.
sentences.zh: 这就是鲁珀特在他儿子的游艇上摔倒时所面临的风险。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell me about these children who were poised to take over the Murdoch media empire.
sentences.zh: 好的，跟我说说这些准备接管默多克媒体帝国的孩子们吧。

sentences.en: So Rupert has six children, two teenage daughters, four adult children, whom we already mentioned.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特有六个孩子，两个十几岁的女儿，四个成年子女，我们之前提到过。

sentences.en: And of those four, the only two who were really in the succession mix were the two boys.
sentences.zh: 在这四个孩子中，真正进入继承人选名单的只有两个儿子。

sentences.en: Either Lachlan, his eldest son, or James, his younger son.
sentences.zh: 要么是长子拉克兰，要么是小儿子詹姆斯。

sentences.en: Okay, so who are these two sons who stand to inherit the company?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这两个有望继承公司的儿子是谁？

sentences.en: Well, there's the firstborn, Lachlan, born in 71, mostly raised in New York.
sentences.zh: 嗯，长子是拉克兰，出生于71年，主要在纽约长大。

sentences.en: And history repeats itself, learning at dad's knee, going over the newspapers every morning.
sentences.zh: 历史重演，他在父亲膝下学习，每天早上翻阅报纸。

sentences.en: He goes to Princeton, he studies philosophy, he's into Hegel and Kant.
sentences.zh: 他去了普林斯顿大学，学习哲学，沉迷于黑格尔和康德。

sentences.en: But he really loves Australia.
sentences.zh: 但他真的很爱澳大利亚。

sentences.en: He identifies with it.
sentences.zh: 他认同那里。

sentences.en: And he takes a series of jobs there where he becomes this kind of this big figure in Australian media because Murdoch's so powerful by then.
sentences.zh: 他在那里做了一系列工作，成为了澳大利亚媒体界的重要人物，因为默多克当时已经非常有权势了。

sentences.en: And he's seen around town on his motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到他骑着摩托车在城里转悠。

sentences.en: He's known for his cool armband tattoo.
sentences.zh: 他以那酷酷的臂章纹身而闻名。

sentences.en: He's a rock climber.
sentences.zh: 他是个攀岩爱好者。

sentences.en: He's like, he had even served as a jackaroo, one of his summer jobs.
sentences.zh: 他甚至还当过牧场工人，那是他暑期工作之一。

sentences.en: What is a jackaroo?
sentences.zh: 什么是牧场工人？

sentences.en: Well, I'm told that a jackaroo kind of helps deal with the, really manhandles the animals on the farm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我听说牧场工人主要是帮忙处理农场里的动物，真的是要亲手驯服它们。

sentences.en: It's like herding.
sentences.zh: 就像放牧一样。

sentences.en: It's like sheep and goat herding and vaccinating.
sentences.zh: 就像放牧羊和山羊，还要给它们打疫苗。

sentences.en: We heard he would literally physically vaccinate the sheep, like inject them.
sentences.zh: 我们听说他真的会亲自给羊打疫苗，就是给它们注射。

sentences.en: So kind of a swashbuckler.
sentences.zh: 所以算是个冒险家吧。

sentences.en: He's a swashbuckler.
sentences.zh: 他是个冒险家。

sentences.en: Very much, yeah.
sentences.zh: 非常像，是的。

sentences.en: And he's known early on to kind of identify with his father's politics.
sentences.zh: 他很早就被认为认同他父亲的政治观点。

sentences.en: But those who work with him say he's even maybe more conservative than his father.
sentences.zh: 但与他共事的人说，他甚至可能比他父亲更保守。

sentences.en: Okay, so that is Lachlan.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是拉克兰。

sentences.en: What about the other son, James?
sentences.zh: 那另一个儿子詹姆斯呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, James is 18 months younger than Lachlan.
sentences.zh: 是的，詹姆斯比拉克兰小18个月。

sentences.en: And he's considered to be the family rebel when he was younger.
sentences.zh: 他年轻时被认为是家里的叛逆者。

sentences.en: He had dyed his hair.
sentences.zh: 他染过头发。

sentences.en: He pierced his ears.
sentences.zh: 他打过耳洞。

sentences.en: He went to Harvard.
sentences.zh: 他去了哈佛大学。

sentences.en: Which is not so rebellious.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不太叛逆。

sentences.en: Well, you know, you can't have everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，人不可能拥有一切。

sentences.en: While at Harvard, he considers becoming a medieval historian.
sentences.zh: 在哈佛期间，他考虑成为一名中世纪历史学家。

sentences.en: So he's considering maybe going into academia, which is kind of a sort of surprising notion for a young Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 所以他考虑进入学术界，这对年轻的默多克来说是一个令人惊讶的想法。

sentences.en: And he ends up dropping out of Harvard.
sentences.zh: 最后他从哈佛退学了。

sentences.en: He goes off to follow the Grateful Dead.
sentences.zh: 他跑去追随感恩而死乐队。

sentences.en: He's like a big deadhead.
sentences.zh: 他是个超级死忠粉。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And after that, he starts a hip-hop label called Raucous Records.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他创办了一家名为Raucous Records的嘻哈唱片公司。

sentences.en: And the label, which actually does very well, I mean, they certainly have some pretty well-known hip-hop artists.
sentences.zh: 这家唱片公司其实做得很好，我的意思是，他们确实有一些非常有名的嘻哈艺人。

sentences.en: And after about a year with him at this hip-hop label, his father buys the label and brings James into the company.
sentences.zh: 在他经营这家嘻哈唱片公司大约一年后，他父亲收购了该公司，并将詹姆斯带进了家族企业。

sentences.en: And that's sort of the end of James' kind of brief foray outside the business.
sentences.zh: 这就是詹姆斯短暂离开家族生意生涯的终结。

sentences.en: And now he's sort of squarely part of the Murdoch Empire and in contention for the throne.
sentences.zh: 现在他完全成为了默多克帝国的一部分，并参与了王位的争夺。

sentences.en: And what are his politics like?
sentences.zh: 他的政治倾向如何？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: James is far, far more centrist than Lachlan.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯比拉克兰要温和得多，多得多。

sentences.en: He's a big, big environmentalist, really sort of focused on climate change.
sentences.zh: 他是个坚定的环保主义者，非常关注气候变化。

sentences.en: You wouldn't call him a liberal, but you would certainly call him a centrist, someone with moderate politics.
sentences.zh: 你不会称他为自由派，但你肯定会称他为中间派，一个政治立场温和的人。

sentences.en: He also had no attachment whatsoever to Australia.
sentences.zh: 他对澳大利亚也完全没有依恋。

sentences.en: It sounds like Lachlan and James are...
sentences.zh: 听起来拉克兰和詹姆斯是……

sentences.en: Oil and water.
sentences.zh: 水火不容。

sentences.en: Not exactly on the same page.
sentences.zh: 完全不在同一个频道上。

sentences.en: Chalk and cheese is the way they put it in Australia.
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚，他们称之为“天差地别”。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And do they get along?
sentences.zh: 他们相处得来吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Really no.
sentences.zh: 真的不。

sentences.en: So you can imagine why they'd have two very different visions and want to take the company in two very different directions.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象为什么他们会有两种截然不同的愿景，并想把公司带向两个完全不同的方向。

sentences.en: And listening to you describe these two, it would feel almost inevitable that Rupert Murdoch would identify a bit more with Lachlan, the Australian-loving, conservatively inclined,
sentences.zh: 听你描述这两个人，感觉鲁珀特·默多克似乎不可避免地会更认同拉克兰，那个热爱澳大利亚、倾向保守派的、

sentences.en: first-born son.
sentences.zh: 长子。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So is Lachlan a kind of obvious choice to run the company?
sentences.zh: 那么拉克兰是管理公司的明显人选吗？

sentences.en: He is definitely the leading contender.
sentences.zh: 他绝对是主要的竞争者。

sentences.en: And Rupert brings Lachlan back from Australia.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特把拉克兰从澳大利亚叫了回来。

sentences.en: And he sets up in New York and he starts working in television stations.
sentences.zh: 他在纽约安顿下来，开始在电视台工作。

sentences.en: He goes and works in L.A.
sentences.zh: 他去洛杉矶工作，

sentences.en: and deals with the movie studios and gets to know the big executives, all of whom have their own ambitions.
sentences.zh: 处理电影制片厂的事务，结识了那些大高管，他们每个人都有自己的野心。

sentences.en: And see Lachlan and his brother, for that matter, as these entitled princelings.
sentences.zh: 他们把拉克兰，以及他的兄弟，看作是享有特权的王子。

sentences.en: And kind of a threat to them.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说是一种威胁。

sentences.en: Definitely a threat to them.
sentences.zh: 绝对是威胁。

sentences.en: And there's some resentment.
sentences.zh: 而且还有一些怨恨。

sentences.en: So it's a frustrating period for Lachlan this time around.
sentences.zh: 所以这对拉克兰来说是一段令人沮丧的时期。

sentences.en: We've heard stories of executives rolling their eyes when Lachlan speaks.
sentences.zh: 我们听说过高管们在拉克兰说话时翻白眼的故事。

sentences.en: Finally, he has a very big clash with the famous chairman of Fox News, Roger Ailes, who's just a bombastic, larger-than-life character and wants nothing to do with Lachlan.
sentences.zh: 最后，他与福克斯新闻著名的董事长罗杰·艾尔斯发生了巨大的冲突，罗杰·艾尔斯是一个夸夸其谈、个性张扬的人，根本不想和拉克兰有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: And when he and Lachlan clash on a pretty small programming issue, Roger Ailes goes to Rupert and it gets back to Lachlan that Rupert says, don't worry about the boy.
sentences.zh: 当他和拉克兰在一个很小的节目编排问题上发生冲突时，罗杰·艾尔斯去找了鲁珀特，然后传回拉克兰耳中，说鲁珀特表示“别管那个孩子”。

sentences.en: And right on the spot, Lachlan quits.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，拉克兰辞职了。

sentences.en: And he up and just leaves the country, right back to Australia.
sentences.zh: 他直接离开了这个国家，回到了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So at this point, does Rupert turn to James as the logical heir?
sentences.zh: 那么在这一点上，鲁珀特会把詹姆斯视为理所当然的继承人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that's exactly what happens.
sentences.zh: 是的，事情正是这样发展的。

sentences.en: Lachlan is gone.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰离开了。

sentences.en: He's in self-imposed exile in Australia.
sentences.zh: 他在澳大利亚进行自我放逐。

sentences.en: And James now steps up and sort of seizes his opportunity to become the heir.
sentences.zh: 而詹姆斯现在挺身而出，抓住了机会，成为了继承人。

sentences.en: And what is James's vision for this media empire?
sentences.zh: 那么詹姆斯对这个媒体帝国有什么愿景呢？

sentences.en: So James has a very different vision from his brother, certainly, and his father.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯的愿景与他的兄弟，当然也与他的父亲，有着非常大的不同。

sentences.en: He's sort of a Davos-style executive, a globalist, who wants to move the company into new markets, move the company away from this sort of purely kind of political identity,
sentences.zh: 他算是一位达沃斯风格的高管，一位全球主义者，他想把公司带入新的市场，让公司摆脱那种纯粹的政治身份，

sentences.en: and become a kind of progressive, carbon-neutral.
sentences.zh: 并成为一种进步的、碳中和的企业。

sentences.en: He actually leads an initiative to convert all of their offices to carbon-neutral.
sentences.zh: 他实际上领导了一项倡议，将他们所有的办公室都转变为碳中和。

sentences.en: That doesn't sound Murdochian.
sentences.zh: 这听起来一点也不像默多克家族的作风。

sentences.en: It does not sound Murdochian, no.
sentences.zh: 确实不像默多克家族的作风，没错。

sentences.en: And in terms of the politics of the company, how it presents the world, the events it chooses to try to influence, what does he see?
sentences.zh: 就公司的政治立场、它如何呈现世界、它选择试图影响的事件而言，他看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he would like the company to be more politically neutral.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他希望公司在政治上更加中立。

sentences.en: I mean, to be a centrist company that isn't pushing a political agenda, but rather is just kind of moving forward with its own agenda.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，成为一家中间派公司，不推行任何政治议程，而是带着自己的议程向前发展。

sentences.en: So, I mean, it's a very different vision than the one that his father had had for so many years during his decades of empire-building and pushing his politics.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，这与他父亲在几十年的帝国建设和推行其政治主张期间所持有的愿景截然不同。

sentences.en: So there's a moment where this company could be very different.
sentences.zh: 所以，曾有一个时刻，这家公司可能会变得非常不同。

sentences.en: And so how does that work out for James?
sentences.zh: 那么这对詹姆斯来说结果如何呢？

sentences.en: Well, he's on his way when...
sentences.zh: 嗯，他正走在路上时……

sentences.en: Media tycoon Rupert Murdoch didn't only deliver the news this week.
sentences.zh: 媒体大亨鲁珀特·默多克本周不仅发布了新闻。

sentences.en: Murdoch was the news.
sentences.zh: 默多克本人就是新闻。

sentences.en: All of his efforts get completely undone by a massive scandal.
sentences.zh: 他所有的努力都被一场巨大的丑闻彻底摧毁了。

sentences.en: Murdoch's journalists have been hacking into the cell phones of the owners and users of those phones.
sentences.zh: 默多克的记者们一直在入侵这些手机所有者和用户的手机。

sentences.en: Police reports say there could be as many as 4,000 victiMs.
sentences.zh: 警方报告称，受害者可能多达4000人。

sentences.en: Really the biggest scandal that the Murdoch family and empire has ever faced.
sentences.zh: 这确实是默多克家族和帝国有史以来面临的最大丑闻。

sentences.en: The paper accused of hacking the phones of celebrities, politicians, and even the voicemail of a murdered teenager.
sentences.zh: 该报被指控入侵名人、政客的手机，甚至窃听了一名被谋杀少女的语音信箱。

sentences.en: One of the Murdoch papers, the News of the World, has been hacking into the phones and stealing their personal messages for dirt to sell papers.
sentences.zh: 默多克旗下的《世界新闻报》一直在入侵人们的手机并窃取他们的私人信息，以此作为卖点来增加报纸销量。

sentences.en: The company's best-selling paper, the News of the World, has been closed down because it became too much of a liability.
sentences.zh: 公司最畅销的报纸《世界新闻报》已被关闭，因为它已成为巨大的负债。

sentences.en: And that becomes an enormous, enormous international front-page scandal in the year 2011.
sentences.zh: 这在2011年演变成了一场巨大的、国际性的头版丑闻。

sentences.en: This story just continues to unfold at a massive rate.
sentences.zh: 这个故事还在以惊人的速度持续发酵。

sentences.en: It sure does, Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，伊丽莎白。

sentences.en: This scandal has rocked his media empire to the core.
sentences.zh: 这场丑闻从根本上撼动了他的媒体帝国。

sentences.en: And James, at the time, is running the company, and it all sort of falls on him.
sentences.zh: 而詹姆斯当时正在管理公司，这一切似乎都落在了他头上。

sentences.en: The issue all along has been how much the management of the paper knew about the phone hacking its reporters were involved in.
sentences.zh: 一直以来的问题是，报社管理层对记者参与的电话窃听事件究竟了解多少。

sentences.en: James Murdoch had signed the check, settling some of the claiMs.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·默多克签署了支票，和解了一些索赔要求。

sentences.en: Really what happens here, you know, you might imagine in some families,
sentences.zh: 这里真正发生的事情是，你知道，你可能会想象在某些家庭里，

sentences.en: this might be a time for the father and son to sort of bond together and figure out how to fight this thing off.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个父子团结一致，想办法共同抵御这场危机的时候。

sentences.en: But what happens in the case of Rupert and James now is they basically blame each other for the hacking scandal.
sentences.zh: 但在鲁珀特和詹姆斯的情况中，他们基本上是在互相指责对方导致了窃听丑闻。

sentences.en: James feels like my father's company is a mess.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯觉得我父亲的公司一团糟。

sentences.en: The culture of this company is out of control.
sentences.zh: 这家公司的文化已经失控了。

sentences.en: And now he's essentially throwing me in front of it, his son.
sentences.zh: 而现在他基本上把我推到了风口浪尖，我是他的儿子啊。

sentences.en: And Rupert feels like, I put you in charge of my operation over there.
sentences.zh: 而鲁珀特觉得，我让你负责我那边的业务。

sentences.en: This scandal has been brewing for years, and you have failed to contain it.
sentences.zh: 这场丑闻已经酝酿多年，而你却没能控制住它。

sentences.en: How is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was a very public family drama.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常公开的家庭闹剧。

sentences.en: A dynasty scrambling to save itself from destruction.
sentences.zh: 一个王朝正在挣扎着从毁灭中拯救自己。

sentences.en: So it's complete chaos.
sentences.zh: 所以这完全是一团糟。

sentences.en: James is blaming Rupert.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯在指责鲁珀特。

sentences.en: Rupert is blaming James.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特在指责詹姆斯。

sentences.en: The whole succession thing is now completely kaput.
sentences.zh: 整个继承权的事情现在彻底泡汤了。

sentences.en: It's up in the air.
sentences.zh: 一切都悬而未决。

sentences.en: There's no clear error apparent.
sentences.zh: 没有明显的继承人。

sentences.en: And then Lachlan returns.
sentences.zh: 然后拉克兰回来了。

sentences.en: He calls his father and says, I'm going to fly there from Australia.
sentences.zh: 他给父亲打电话说，我要从澳大利亚飞过去。

sentences.en: Lachlan arrives in London.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰抵达伦敦。

sentences.en: He swoops into the offices there.
sentences.zh: 他迅速入驻了那里的办公室。

sentences.en: He is tan.
sentences.zh: 他晒黑了。

sentences.en: He's fit.
sentences.zh: 他很健壮。

sentences.en: He's somehow miraculously looking rested, even though he's just flown halfway around the world.
sentences.zh: 尽管他刚飞越半个地球，但他看起来奇迹般地精神饱满。

sentences.en: And he is sort of instantly a comfort to his father.
sentences.zh: 他似乎瞬间成了父亲的慰藉。

sentences.en: And so suddenly he may, in fact, be back in the game as an heir to this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 于是突然之间，他可能真的又回到了这场帝国继承的游戏中。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Lachlan Murdoch, it looks like, is going to emerge.
sentences.zh: 看起来拉克兰·默多克要脱颖而出了。

sentences.en: One time the clear crown prince, then a dark horse, now back in the game.
sentences.zh: 曾经明确的王储，后来成了黑马，现在又回到了游戏中。

sentences.en: So for a couple of years, it seems as though Lachlan is now just kind of edging James out.
sentences.zh: 所以有几年时间，看起来拉克兰似乎正在把詹姆斯挤出局。

sentences.en: As a result, many believe that this makes Lachlan the heir apparent to take over his father's media empire.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多人认为这使得拉克兰成为接管他父亲媒体帝国的当然继承人。

sentences.en: Mr. Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 默多克先生。

sentences.en: There's also this seemingly reversal of fortunes for James Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·默多克的命运似乎也出现了反转。

sentences.en: But Rupert hasn't made a decision yet.
sentences.zh: 但鲁珀特还没有做出决定。

sentences.en: To do so, for one, would sort of suggest his own mortality.
sentences.zh: 首先，这样做似乎暗示了他自己的终将老去。

sentences.en: But it's also entirely possible that he, in fact, doesn't trust either one of his sons to take over his empire.
sentences.zh: 但同样完全有可能的是，他实际上并不信任他的任何一个儿子来接管他的帝国。

sentences.en: So that's where things are when he trips and falls on the yacht.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是他在游艇上摔倒时的情况。

sentences.en: And once again, everything is up in the air.
sentences.zh: 一切又回到了悬而未决的状态。

sentences.en: So what ends up happening to Rupert Murdoch after this pretty bad fall?
sentences.zh: 那么鲁珀特·默多克在这次相当严重的摔倒后最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: So not only does Rupert Murdoch recover, he goes on to do something incredibly surprising, something incredibly dramatic.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特·默多克不仅康复了，他还继续做了一些令人难以置信的惊人举动，一些极其戏剧性的事情。

sentences.en: Well, there's Rupert Murdoch, and for more than 50 years, his media empire has been getting bigger and bigger.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是鲁珀特·默多克，五十多年来，他的媒体帝国一直在不断壮大。

sentences.en: But today, all of that changed.
sentences.zh: 但今天，这一切都改变了。

sentences.en: And in fact, un-Murdochian.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这很不“默多克”。

sentences.en: Let's start with one of the biggest deals the media industry has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 让我们从媒体行业有史以来最大的交易之一说起。

sentences.en: He proceeds with what is ultimately the single biggest deal of his life.
sentences.zh: 他进行了他一生中最大的一笔交易。

sentences.en: And what's that deal?
sentences.zh: 那是什么交易？

sentences.en: He sells.
sentences.zh: 他卖掉了。

sentences.en: A mega merger to combine Disney with much of 21st Century Fox.
sentences.zh: 这是一次将迪士尼与21世纪福克斯大部分业务合并的超级并购。

sentences.en: He sells roughly two-thirds of the company, 21st Century Fox, the massive Hollywood studio, to Disney.
sentences.zh: 他将公司约三分之二的资产，即21世纪福克斯这个庞大的好莱坞制片厂，卖给了迪士尼。

sentences.en: Two-thirds of his company in one deal?
sentences.zh: 一笔交易卖掉了他公司三分之二的资产？

sentences.en: In one fell swoop.
sentences.zh: 一举完成。

sentences.en: And why is Murdoch doing this?
sentences.zh: 默多克为什么要这样做？

sentences.en: So it's a solution really on two levels.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上是在两个层面上解决问题。

sentences.en: On one, it's a solution to his business problem,
sentences.zh: 一方面，这是对他商业问题的解决方案，

sentences.en: which is that it's becoming increasingly difficult for him to compete with the new tech streaming companies like Netflix and Amazon and Apple.
sentences.zh: 那就是他越来越难以与Netflix、亚马逊和苹果等新兴科技流媒体公司竞争。

sentences.en: But it's also a solution to the succession problem.
sentences.zh: 但这也是对继承问题的解决方案。

sentences.en: He's got these two sons.
sentences.zh: 他有两个儿子。

sentences.en: They're at each other's throats.
sentences.zh: 他们争得你死我活。

sentences.en: They don't get along.
sentences.zh: 他们相处不来。

sentences.en: It's believed he doesn't necessarily even trust either one of them to carry the big company forward.
sentences.zh: 人们认为他甚至不一定信任他们中的任何一个来带领大公司前进。

sentences.en: So now he will shrink the company, give it to one of the sons, and the other one can go on his merry way.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他将缩小公司规模，把它交给其中一个儿子，另一个可以走自己的路。

sentences.en: So what's left of this company and who is to lead it?
sentences.zh: 那么这家公司还剩下什么，由谁来领导？

sentences.en: Which one of them?
sentences.zh: 他们中的哪一个？

sentences.en: So what's left are really the tools of influence, a political weapon.
sentences.zh: 剩下的实际上是影响力的工具，一种政治武器。

sentences.en: It's Fox News.
sentences.zh: 那就是福克斯新闻。

sentences.en: It's the Murdoch newspapers around the world.
sentences.zh: 那是世界各地的默多克报纸。

sentences.en: It's a diminished empire, but it's still a very politically potent empire.
sentences.zh: 这是一个缩小的帝国，但它仍然是一个政治影响力巨大的帝国。

sentences.en: And the man who is left to run it is Lachlan.
sentences.zh: 而留下来管理它的人是拉克兰。

sentences.en: He, at this moment, becomes the true heir.
sentences.zh: 他在这一刻成为了真正的继承人。

sentences.en: He takes the throne.
sentences.zh: 他登上了王位。

sentences.en: And what does Lachlan do with these tools of influence that we know well, especially here in the United States, that he now has control over?
sentences.zh: 拉克兰对他现在掌控的这些我们非常熟悉的、特别是在美国的影响力工具做了什么？

sentences.en: Not you, but I'm sick and tired of political correctness, censorship, and fake news.
sentences.zh: 不是你，但我对政治正确、审查制度和假新闻感到厌倦了。

sentences.en: Well, he's clearly moving the company in the same direction that his father was taking it in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他显然正在带领公司朝着他父亲曾经的方向前进。

sentences.en: This is your nation.
sentences.zh: 这是你们的国家。

sentences.en: This is our nation.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的国家。

sentences.en: This is Fox Nation.
sentences.zh: 这是福克斯国家。

sentences.en: One of the first things he does is he launches this new streaming service called Fox Nation.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事就是推出了这个名为“福克斯国家”的新流媒体服务。

sentences.en: And along with my Fox Nation friends, we're going to give you that place where your values, your communities, your voice is represented.
sentences.zh: 和我所有的“福克斯国家”朋友们一起，我们将为你提供一个地方，让你的价值观、你的社区、你的声音得到代表。

sentences.en: And yes, at times it may be politically incorrect, but it will always be intellectually honeSt.
sentences.zh: 是的，有时它可能在政治上不正确，但它永远会在智识上诚实。

sentences.en: And it's sort of built for Fox superfans.
sentences.zh: 它基本上是为福克斯的超级粉丝打造的。

sentences.en: They pay subscriptions so they don't have to worry about advertising boycotts.
sentences.zh: 他们支付订阅费，这样他们就不必担心广告抵制。

sentences.en: So it can be even sort of edgier and even more right wing.
sentences.zh: 所以它可以变得更加尖锐，甚至更加右翼。

sentences.en: Are you freaking kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: She thinks voting for someone other than her lying, email deleting, rotten self must be motivated by racism and white supremacy.
sentences.zh: 她认为投票给除了她自己那个撒谎、删除邮件、腐烂透顶的人之外的任何人，一定是出于种族主义和白人至上主义。

sentences.en: How absolutely false and disgusting.
sentences.zh: 这是多么虚假和令人作呕。

sentences.en: So he's basically moving the network even more directly toward the base.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是在把电视网更直接地推向核心受众。

sentences.en: That's been her specialty and the only thing she's done since November 2016.
sentences.zh: 那是她的专长，也是她自2016年11月以来唯一做的事情。

sentences.en: And on top of that, it's easy to see how the whole empire could actually become more conservative now.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，很容易看出整个帝国现在实际上可能变得更加保守。

sentences.en: Because 21st Century Fox was this massive liberal Hollywood studio, which served as a kind of check on some of the truly kind of hardcore right wing impulses of the empire.
sentences.zh: 因为21世纪福克斯曾是一个庞大的自由派好莱坞制片厂，它对帝国中一些真正强硬的右翼冲动起到了一种制衡作用。

sentences.en: So that's gone.
sentences.zh: 所以现在那个制衡消失了。

sentences.en: And now, of course, James is gone.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在詹姆斯也离开了。

sentences.en: And James, as we know, was trying to push the company into a more politically neutral direction.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，詹姆斯曾试图推动公司向更政治中立的方向发展。

sentences.en: So those two impediments have been removed.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个障碍都已经被清除了。

sentences.en: And now it can really march further and more aggressively to the right.
sentences.zh: 现在它可以真正更进一步、更激进地向右转。

sentences.en: And Jim, what happens to James Murdoch now?
sentences.zh: 吉姆，詹姆斯·默多克现在怎么样了？

sentences.en: He's interestingly going to join with his wife to, among other things, invest in programs that combat the things they worry about Fox causing.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他将与妻子联手，除其他事项外，投资于那些旨在对抗他们所担心的福克斯所造成的问题的项目。

sentences.en: They are going to invest in programs to fight a liberalism around the world, boost centrist political organizations,
sentences.zh: 他们将投资于打击全球非自由主义的项目，支持中间派政治组织，

sentences.en: invest in voting and things that are really kind of counter-programming to the ideology that the empire he's leaving behind pumps out regularly.
sentences.zh: 投资于投票以及其他真正与他留下的帝国所定期输出的意识形态相抗衡的项目。

sentences.en: So it's no longer a succession drama.
sentences.zh: 所以这不再是一场继承权之争了。

sentences.en: Succession has finally been resolved.
sentences.zh: 继承问题终于解决了。

sentences.en: But it's still a family drama because James is now going off on his own with every intention of investing in big initiatives to effectively undermine the political agenda of the Murdoch empire.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然是一场家庭闹剧，因为詹姆斯现在要单干了，他完全打算投资大型项目，以有效地破坏默多克帝国的政治议程。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And so, essentially, the war over this business will take a new form.
sentences.zh: 所以，本质上，围绕这项业务的战争将采取新的形式。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: James will be on the outside.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯将在外面。

sentences.en: Lachlan will be on the inside.
sentences.zh: 拉克兰将在里面。

sentences.en: But the war will continue.
sentences.zh: 但战争将继续。

sentences.en: Jonathan, Jim, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，吉姆，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 感激不尽。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The crew performed all the procedures repeatedly provided by the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 机组人员执行了制造商反复提供的所有程序。

sentences.en: Investigators have found that the pilots of a Boeing 737 MAX 8 that crashed in Ethiopia followed the emergency safety procedures recommended by Boeing,
sentences.zh: 调查人员发现，在埃塞俄比亚坠毁的波音737 MAX 8飞机的飞行员遵循了波音公司建议的紧急安全程序，

sentences.en: suggesting that pilot error, suggesting that pilot error was not a factor in the jet's crash.
sentences.zh: 暗示飞行员失误，暗示飞行员失误并非导致该喷气式飞机坠毁的因素。

sentences.en: The investigation has concluded that moments after takeoff, one of the jet's sensors began fluctuating wildly, erroneously indicating that the jet was about to stall,
sentences.zh: 调查结论显示，在起飞后不久，该喷气式飞机的一个传感器开始剧烈波动，错误地显示飞机即将失速，

sentences.en: triggering an automated system that pushed down its nose, a situation that doomed the same Boeing model in Indonesia six months ago.
sentences.zh: 从而触发了一个自动系统，将机头向下压，六个月前在印度尼西亚坠毁的同一型号波音飞机也遭遇了这种情况。

sentences.en: The pilots in Ethiopia then did what Boeing recommends, cutting off electricity to the automated system.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚的飞行员随后采取了波音公司建议的操作，切断了该自动系统的电源。

sentences.en: But the nose kept pushing down, and the jet quickly crashed, killing everyone on board.
sentences.zh: 但机头依然持续下压，飞机很快坠毁，机上所有人员全部遇难。

sentences.en: It is recommended that the aircraft flight control system related to the flight's controllability shall be reviewed by the manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 建议制造商对与飞行可控性相关的飞机飞行控制系统进行审查。

sentences.en: And in a major reversal,
sentences.zh: 在一项重大转变中，

sentences.en: the Mormon Church said that it would no longer treat same-sex couples as unworthy of the faith and would end a ban on baptizing the children of same-sex couples.
sentences.zh: 摩门教宣布，将不再把同性伴侣视为不配信仰，并将取消禁止为同性伴侣子女洗礼的规定。

sentences.en: The decision rolls back a 2015 rule that has ripped apart Mormon congregations and driven away many church members.
sentences.zh: 这一决定撤销了2015年的一项规定，该规定曾导致摩门教信众分裂，并使许多教会成员流失。

sentences.en: The Times reports that the change in policy is an attempt to bring those members back and bring the Mormon Church in line with mainstream American views.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，政策的这一改变旨在吸引这些成员回归，并使摩门教与美国主流观点保持一致。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
